summary: Discover effective strategies for talent management in oil and gas. Our training equips you with the skills to optimize your workforce and boost performance.
lede: Strategic talent management in oil and gas helps organizations identify, develop, and retain the specialized capabilities needed for complex operations and the energy transition. It connects workforce planning with long-term operational goals while supporting knowledge transfer and reducing succession risk in high-stakes environments. This course shows you how to forecast workforce demand, assess competency gaps, develop high-potential specialists, and use talent metrics to guide decisions. You will practice building competency matrices, designing accelerated development programs, applying the 70-20-10 learning model, and using HRIS data to support predictive turnover analysis and performance management.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the human capital lifecycle within the energy, petrochemical, and natural resources sectors.
audience: Organizational Development Consultants focused on energy sector
modules: Energy Sector Talent Context and Drivers
Talent Acquisition in a Competitive Market
ESG, Diversity, and the Social License
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in HR, workforce planning, or operations management within the energy or heavy industrial sectors. Familiarity with basic HRIS functions and organizational structures is recommended.
